items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复和iPSC药物发现的研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究生涯的回顾性文章，总结了从基础神经发育研究到iPSC药物发现的转化历程。关键内容包括：1) 发现RNA结合蛋白Musashi在神经干细胞中的功能；2) 建立神经干/祖细胞分离方法；3) 开展脊髓损伤的临床前和首次人体临床试验；4) 利用患者来源iPSC筛选出ALS候选药物Ropinirole。文章强调多学科整合对未来再生医学的重要性。
items.insight: 这篇文章对ALS研究者具有重要价值，因为它详细描述了iPSC药物发现平台从基础研究到临床转化的完整路径，特别是Ropinirole的发现过程，展示了如何将细胞表型与临床反应相结合，为ALS药物开发提供了可复制的范式。

aiRead.keyFinding: iPSC技术成功应用于ALS药物发现，筛选出Ropinirole作为治疗候选，并实现了干细胞移植治疗脊髓损伤的首次人体试验。
aiRead.limitation: 作为个人回顾性文章，可能带有主观性，且未提供具体实验数据或临床试验结果细节。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Ropinirole在ALS中的后续临床试验结果，以及iPSC衍生细胞移植在脊髓损伤中的长期安全性和有效性数据。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和iPSC药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控的研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，从损伤病理生理学分析和分子干预，到使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终导致了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了Ropinirole作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于2026年，总结了iPSC药物发现和干细胞移植的最新进展，直接涉及ALS药物筛选和脊髓损伤再生治疗，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了135例ALS患者的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声数据，发现女性患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR较低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积也较小，且女性患者疾病进展率更高。这些差异在调整年龄、BMI等变量后部分仍存在，提示性别和体型可能影响ALS中炎症和神经肌肉指标的解读。但研究缺乏健康对照组，无法确定这些差异是否由ALS本身引起。
items.insight: 该研究提示性别是ALS临床评估中不可忽视的变量，可能影响炎症标志物和超声测量的解读，为未来ALS临床试验的性别分层设计和预后模型优化提供了依据。

aiRead.keyFinding: 女性ALS患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数、ESR、咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积低于男性，且女性进展率更高。
aiRead.limitation: 无健康对照组，无法区分ALS特异性效应；单中心、回顾性设计，样本量有限；超声测量可能受操作者影响。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注包含健康对照和纵向随访的性别分层研究，以及身体成分（如肌肉质量）对炎症和超声指标的影响。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种具有显著临床异质性的进行性神经退行性疾病。系统性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量均已在ALS中研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在检查ALS患者常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用的临床和人体测量变量后是否持续存在。这项回顾性横断面研究纳入135例ALS患者。分析了常规炎症标志物（包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率（ESR））以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行性别间比较，并应用错误发现率（FDR）校正以处理多重检验。多变量线性回归分析调整了年龄、病程、体重指数（BMI）、ALSFRS-R总分、FVC%预计值、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。在未调整的比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。经FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍显著不同，而ALSFRS-R差异为临界显著。在完全调整模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析中关联不稳定。探索性二次分析显示，完全调整后女性患者大腿抬高时股直肌横截面积较低。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未在早期调整模型中出现而被谨慎解读。在该ALS队列中，选定的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者间存在差异。这些发现支持在解读炎症标志物和超声结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景（包括体型）。由于缺乏健康对照，观察到的超声差异不能特异性地归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究，以阐明这些观察的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦ALS中性别相关的炎症和神经肌肉超声差异，具有新近性，并直接关联ALS临床评估和试验设计。

items.title: Pathology of general proprioception in a canine disease model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Some forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are associated with sequence variants in the superoxide dismutase 1 gene (SOD1). The mechanisms by which these variants contribute to ALS disease pathogenesis are poorly understood. Degenerative myelopathy (DM), a naturally occurring canine disease, shares similarities with some forms of SOD1-associated ALS, especially cases with sensory impairment. While motor pathway involvement in ALS has been extensively studied, sensory pathology has received comparatively less attention. To investigate whether pathology in the general proprioceptive pathway is associated with pelvic limb general proprioceptive ataxia, an early DM sign, we examined sensory system components of this pathway from Pembroke Welsh Corgis with early- and late-stage DM and age-matched controls. The disease was characterized by axonal pathology in the spinocerebellar tracts and the fasciculus gracilis, pronounced accumulation of SOD1-positive inclusions in nucleus thoracicus and dorsal root ganglia (DRG) neurons, and altered SOD1 immunolabeling in dorsal and ventral root axons and ensheathing myelin. Axonal pathology was also observed in a pelvic limb sensory nerve. These findings suggest that pathology in the proprioceptive sensory pathways may play a significant role in general proprioceptive ataxia in DM. Some dogs that were homozygous for the SOD1 risk allele did not develop clinical disease or the associated neuropathology, indicating that other factors in addition to the SOD1 mutation influence disease onset and progression.
items.titleZh: 犬肌萎缩侧索硬化疾病模型中一般本体感觉的病理学
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用犬类退行性脊髓病（DM）作为ALS的模型，发现本体感觉通路（包括脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核和背根神经节）存在显著的病理改变，如轴突变性和SOD1阳性包涵体积累。这些改变与早期共济失调症状相关，提示感觉通路病理在ALS中可能被低估。此外，部分携带SOD1风险基因的犬未发病，说明其他因素也参与疾病发生。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS的感觉系统受累提供了新的动物模型证据，提示本体感觉通路病理可能是疾病早期表现的一部分，值得ALS研究者关注以探索新的生物标志物和治疗靶点。

aiRead.keyFinding: 犬DM模型中本体感觉通路（脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核、DRG）出现轴突病理和SOD1包涵体积累，与共济失调相关。
aiRead.limitation: 犬模型与人类ALS存在差异，且部分基因型未发病提示其他因素影响，需进一步验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否在人类ALS患者中验证本体感觉通路病理，以及SOD1突变以外的修饰因素。

items.abstractZh: 某些形式的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1）的序列变异相关。这些变异导致ALS疾病发病机制的机制尚不清楚。退行性脊髓病（DM）是一种自然发生的犬类疾病，与某些形式的SOD1相关ALS（尤其是伴有感觉障碍的病例）具有相似性。虽然ALS中运动通路的受累已被广泛研究，但感觉病理学受到的关注相对较少。为了研究一般本体感觉通路中的病理是否与骨盆肢体一般本体感觉性共济失调（DM的早期体征）相关，我们检查了来自彭布罗克威尔士柯基犬（早期和晚期DM）及年龄匹配对照的该通路的感觉系统组成部分。该疾病的特征包括脊髓小脑束和薄束中的轴突病理、胸核和背根神经节（DRG）神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体的显著积累，以及背根和腹根轴突及其髓鞘中SOD1免疫标记的改变。在骨盆肢体感觉神经中也观察到轴突病理。这些发现表明，本体感觉通路中的病理可能在DM的一般本体感觉性共济失调中发挥重要作用。一些SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬并未发展出临床疾病或相关的神经病理学，表明除SOD1突变外，其他因素也影响疾病的发病和进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，利用自然发生的犬类疾病模型，揭示了ALS中本体感觉通路的新病理特征，具有转化价值。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.

items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 法国19个中心46名SOD1-ALS患者的真实世界数据显示，使用Tofersen治疗12个月后，功能衰退速度（ALSFRS-R）减缓约58%，血液NfL水平下降约67%。与历史对照相比，治疗组中位生存期延长约11个月，死亡风险降低66%。研究为观察性证据，存在回顾性设计固有局限。
items.insight: 这是SOD1-ALS靶向治疗在真实世界人群中的较大规模多中心证据，直接补充了关键临床试验之外的数据，对评估Tofersen在法国临床实践中的实际获益和生存影响具有重要参考价值。

aiRead.studyType: 多中心回顾性真实世界队列研究（含倾向评分匹配历史对照）
aiRead.keyFinding: Tofersen治疗12个月显著减缓ALSFRS-R进展率（0.53→0.22点/月）并降低NfL水平（89→29.2 pg/ml），且与历史对照相比死亡风险降低66%（HR=0.34）。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计、样本量较小（N=46）、ALSFRS-R对功能变化敏感性有限，且与历史队列的比较可能受未测量混杂因素影响。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Tofersen长期（>12个月）疗效维持、对生存获益的进一步验证，以及来自其他国家的更大规模真实世界注册数据。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估Tofersen在法国真实世界环境中对超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的对照。研究纳入来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALSFRS-R进展率从基线的0.53±0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22±0.3点/月（P=.006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0±9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2±19.5 pg/ml（P=.004）。与倾向评分匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率组间无统计学显著差异（P=.30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分组间差异显著（时间-治疗交互作用P=.006）。倾向评分匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P=.004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P=.03）。Tofersen似乎与较慢的功能衰退和NfL水平降低相关。尽管必须承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，这些发现提供了提示Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究提供了Tofersen在真实世界SOD1-ALS患者中延缓功能衰退、降低NfL并改善生存的最新证据，具有直接的ALS转化治疗价值。

items.title: Neutralization of pathogenic PC-OxPL by AAV-delivered scFv as a therapeutic strategy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder defined by progressive motor neuron loss and TDP-43 proteinopathy, yet the upstream drivers of this pathology remain unclear. Oxidized phosphatidylcholines (PC-OxPL) have emerged as potent inducers of proteinopathy in the central nervous system (CNS), but their role in ALS has not been systematically explored. We identify a distinct PC-OxPL signature in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of patients with sporadic ALS (sALS) and show that apolipoprotein E (apoE)-containing particles are the primary PC-OxPL carriers in this compartment. In human iPSC-derived motor neurons, PC-OxPL exposure triggered disease-relevant transcriptional alterations and TDP-43 pathology, establishing PC-OxPL as a mediator of ALS-like neurodegeneration in vitro . To counteract this toxicity, we engineered an Adeno-Associated Virus (AAV)-delivered single-chain antibody fragment (scFv), PC-OxPL-VecTab, targeting PC-OxPL neoepitopes. PC-OxPL-VecTab neutralized PC-OxPL-induced neurotoxicity, reduced TDP-43 aggregation, and prevented motor neuron death and behavioral deficits in a sALS CSF transfer mouse model. Intrathecal delivery of PC-OxPL-VecTab in minipigs achieved broad CNS biodistribution and transgene expression, supporting the feasibility of CNS delivery. These findings position PC-OxPL as a mechanistic contributor to ALS pathogenesis and establish PC-OxPL-VecTab as a therapeutic strategy for ALS with potential broader applicability to disorders associated with PC-OxPL accumulation.
items.titleZh: 通过AAV递送的scFv中和致病性PC-OxPL作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，散发性ALS患者脑脊液中的氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）水平具有独特特征，且主要由含apoE的颗粒携带。体外实验显示PC-OxPL可诱导运动神经元TDP-43病理和转录改变。研究者开发了AAV递送的scFv抗体PC-OxPL-VecTab，可在小鼠模型中中和PC-OxPL毒性、减少TDP-43聚集并改善行为缺陷，在小型猪中鞘内递送也显示出良好的中枢神经系统分布。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统地将PC-OxPL与ALS发病机制联系起来，不仅提供了新的疾病生物标志物候选，还展示了一种可直接靶向致病脂质新表位的基因治疗策略，为ALS治疗开辟了全新方向。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种以进行性运动神经元丢失和TDP-43蛋白病为特征的致命性神经退行性疾病，但其病理的上游驱动因素仍不清楚。氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）已被证明是中枢神经系统中蛋白病的强效诱导剂，但其在ALS中的作用尚未被系统探索。我们在散发性ALS（sALS）患者的脑脊液（CSF）中鉴定出独特的PC-OxPL特征，并显示含载脂蛋白E（apoE）的颗粒是该区室中PC-OxPL的主要载体。在人类iPSC来源的运动神经元中，PC-OxPL暴露触发了疾病相关的转录改变和TDP-43病理，确立了PC-OxPL作为ALS样神经退行性变的体外介质。为对抗这种毒性，我们设计了一种AAV递送的单链抗体片段（scFv）PC-OxPL-VecTab，靶向PC-OxPL新表位。PC-OxPL-VecTab中和了PC-OxPL诱导的神经毒性，减少了TDP-43聚集，并在sALS CSF转移小鼠模型中阻止了运动神经元死亡和行为缺陷。在小型猪中鞘内递送PC-OxPL-VecTab实现了广泛的中枢神经系统生物分布和转基因表达，支持中枢神经系统递送的可行性。这些发现将PC-OxPL定位为ALS发病机制的机制性贡献者，并确立PC-OxPL-VecTab作为ALS的治疗策略，且可能更广泛适用于与PC-OxPL积累相关的疾病。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，首次将PC-OxPL确立为ALS的机制性驱动因素，并提供了从患者样本到动物模型再到大型动物递送的完整转化证据链，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: i.c.v. delivery of AAV9-synapsin-promoted caveolin-1 attenuates neuromuscular deficits and neuromuscular degeneration in hSOD1 G93A mice.
items.summary: Practical and broad biodistributable gene delivery interventions are essential for advancing therapeutic strategies targeting neurodegenerative diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). We previously demonstrated that subpial delivery of AAV9-synapsin-promoted caveolin-1 ( SynCav1 ) afforded significant neuroprotective effects in mutant superoxide dismutase (SOD)-1-induced ALS pathology. However, subpial delivery is regionally restricted, technically challenging, and highly invasive. This study evaluated whether the intracerebroventricular (i.c.v.) route of administration (ROA), an alternative CNS delivery strategy less invasive than direct spinal cord injections, could achieve broader CNS biodistribution and produce functional or histological benefits in hSOD1 G93A mice. i.c.v. administration of AAV9- SynCav1 achieved widespread Cav-1 overexpression in the motor cortex and spinal cord. SynCav1 -treated male mice exhibited improved running wheel (RW) performance and better motor-evoked potentials. Immunofluorescence revealed attenuated degeneration of cholinergic motor neurons (MNs) in the cervical and lumbar ventral horn, as well as preserved diaphragm neuromuscular junction (NMJ) innervation in SynCav1- treated mice. These findings serve as preclinical proof of concept that i.c.v. delivery of AAV9- SynCav1 can achieve CNS target engagement and produce selective functional and anatomical benefits in hSOD1 G93A mice.
items.titleZh: 脑室内递送AAV9-synapsin启动子驱动的caveolin-1可减轻hSOD1 G93A小鼠的神经肌肉缺陷和神经肌肉变性
items.summaryZh: 这项研究测试了一种新的基因递送方法：通过脑室内注射AAV9-SynCav1，在ALS小鼠模型中实现更广泛的CNS分布。结果显示，该方法能有效过表达caveolin-1，改善运动功能，并保护运动神经元和神经肌肉接头。相比侵入性更强的软膜下注射，脑室内注射可能更安全、更易操作，为ALS基因治疗提供了新的递送策略。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS基因治疗提供了一种侵入性更小的递送途径，通过脑室内注射AAV9-SynCav1实现了广泛的CNS靶向，并展示了功能性和组织学改善，值得ALS研究者关注，因为它可能推动基因治疗向临床转化。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前动物实验（hSOD1 G93A小鼠模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: 脑室内递送AAV9-SynCav1可实现运动皮层和脊髓的广泛Cav-1过表达，改善运动功能，并减轻运动神经元变性和神经肌肉接头去神经支配。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅在动物模型中进行，未涉及人类；且未报告长期安全性或疗效数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该递送策略在非人灵长类中的安全性和有效性，以及SynCav1在其他ALS模型（如C9orf72）中的验证。

items.abstractZh: 实用且广泛生物分布的基因递送干预对于推进针对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）等神经退行性疾病的治疗策略至关重要。我们先前证明，软膜下递送AAV9-synapsin启动子驱动的caveolin-1（SynCav1）在突变超氧化物歧化酶（SOD1）诱导的ALS病理中具有显著的神经保护作用。然而，软膜下递送具有区域限制性、技术挑战性且高度侵入性。本研究评估了脑室内（i.c.v.）给药途径（ROA）——一种比直接脊髓注射侵入性更小的替代性中枢神经系统（CNS）递送策略——是否能在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中实现更广泛的CNS生物分布并产生功能或组织学益处。i.c.v.给予AAV9-SynCav1在运动皮层和脊髓中实现了广泛的Cav-1过表达。SynCav1处理的雄性小鼠表现出改善的跑轮（RW）表现和更好的运动诱发电位。免疫荧光显示，SynCav1处理的小鼠颈段和腰段腹角胆碱能运动神经元（MNs）的变性减轻，以及膈肌神经肌肉接头（NMJ）支配的保留。这些发现作为临床前概念验证，表明i.c.v.递送AAV9-SynCav1可以实现CNS靶点参与，并在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中产生选择性的功能和解剖学益处。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用脑室内递送AAV9-SynCav1，相比传统侵入性方法更安全且能实现广泛CNS分布，为ALS基因治疗提供了新的转化路径，具有近期性和转化价值。

items.title: Cell Death in Neurodegenerative Diseases: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Targets.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDs) are marked by selective neuronal vulnerability and progressive failure of neural circuits. Increasing evidence indicates that neuronal loss is not driven by a single terminal event, but emerges from interacting regulated cell death (RCD) programs. These programs are closely coupled to mitochondrial injury, proteostatic collapse, lysosomal stress, metabolic imbalance, glial state transitions, and chronic neuroinflammation. Yet, how distinct death pathways are organized across cell types, disease stages, and disease-specific microenvironments remains unresolved. This review examines RCD as an integrated pathogenic network in major NDs. Caspase and B-cell lymphoma 2 (BCL2) family signaling, receptor-interacting protein kinase 1 (RIPK1), RIPK3, and mixed lineage kinase domain-like protein activation, NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain containing 3 and gasdermin signaling, GPX4-linked lipid peroxidation control, and autophagy lysosomal failure are discussed as convergent stress response modules rather than isolated pathways. Across Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and Huntington's disease, these modules shape neuronal fate through disease-specific interactions with mitochondrial dysfunction, iron dyshomeostasis, inflammasome activation, and microglial metabolic remodeling. We further evaluate emerging therapeutic strategies that target cell death crosstalk, restore autophagy lysosomal competence, or improve delivery to the central nervous system, highlighting the importance of molecular selectivity, cellular context, disease stage, and translational feasibility.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的细胞死亡：分子机制与治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出，神经退行性疾病中的神经元死亡不是单一事件，而是由多种调节性细胞死亡程序（如凋亡、坏死性凋亡、焦亡、铁死亡和自噬性死亡）相互作用形成的网络。这些程序与线粒体损伤、蛋白稳态失衡、神经炎症等密切相关，并在不同疾病（包括ALS）中呈现特异性组合。文章还讨论了针对这些死亡途径的潜在治疗策略，强调需要根据疾病阶段和细胞类型进行精准干预。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了细胞死亡机制的综合框架，有助于理解ALS中运动神经元死亡的复杂性，并指导开发靶向多个死亡途径的联合治疗策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: 神经退行性疾病中的细胞死亡是由多种调节性细胞死亡程序组成的整合网络，而非单一途径。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供新的实验数据，且对具体疾病（如ALS）的机制细节讨论可能不够深入。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对细胞死亡串扰的联合治疗策略在ALS动物模型中的验证，以及RIPK1、GPX4等靶点的临床转化进展。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDs）以选择性神经元易损性和神经回路进行性衰竭为特征。越来越多的证据表明，神经元丢失并非由单一终末事件驱动，而是源于相互作用的调节性细胞死亡（RCD）程序。这些程序与线粒体损伤、蛋白稳态崩溃、溶酶体应激、代谢失衡、胶质细胞状态转变和慢性神经炎症密切相关。然而，不同死亡途径如何在细胞类型、疾病阶段和疾病特异性微环境中组织仍不清楚。本综述将RCD视为主要神经退行性疾病中的整合致病网络。讨论了半胱天冬酶和B细胞淋巴瘤2（BCL2）家族信号、受体相互作用蛋白激酶1（RIPK1）、RIPK3和混合谱系激酶结构域样蛋白激活、NOD样受体家族含pyrin结构域蛋白3和gasdermin信号、GPX4相关的脂质过氧化控制以及自噬溶酶体衰竭，这些被视为汇聚的应激反应模块而非孤立途径。在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和亨廷顿病中，这些模块通过与线粒体功能障碍、铁稳态失调、炎症小体激活和小胶质细胞代谢重塑的疾病特异性相互作用来塑造神经元命运。我们进一步评估了针对细胞死亡串扰、恢复自噬溶酶体能力或改善中枢神经系统递送的新兴治疗策略，强调了分子选择性、细胞背景、疾病阶段和转化可行性的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了最新的调节性细胞死亡研究进展，强调了细胞死亡途径间的串扰及其在ALS等疾病中的转化治疗潜力，具有高度的ALS相关性和新近性。

items.title: Gut microbiota and brain health: Disease-specific pathways and emerging therapeutic strategies.
items.summary: The microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA) has emerged as a dynamic, bidirectional communication system linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system (CNS) through neural, immune, endocrine, and metabolic mechanisms. Increasing evidence indicates that alterations in gut microbial communities are associated with a wide range of neurological disorders; however, the strength of this association varies across diseases, and many mechanistic observations still rely predominantly on experimental models rather than human studies. This review provides an overview of current evidence regarding the role of the gut microbiota in maintaining CNS homeostasis, with particular emphasis on intestinal barrier function, immune modulation, vagal and enteric communication, and the generation of biologically active microbial metabolites, including short-chain fatty acids, bile acids, and neurotransmitter-related compounds. Studies in both clinical and experimental settings have reported disease-specific microbial signatures in conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism spectrum disorders, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In parallel, microbiota-directed interventions-including probiotics, prebiotics, dietary approaches, fecal microbiota transplantation, and strategies targeting microbial metabolites-have produced encouraging findings in preclinical studies and early-stage clinical investigations. Nevertheless, considerable heterogeneity in study populations, experimental methodologies, and therapeutic protocols continues to limit the translation of these findings into routine clinical practice. Collectively, current evidence supports the MGBA as a valuable framework for understanding neurological diseases while underscoring the need for rigorously designed longitudinal studies and well-controlled clinical trials to define its therapeutic relevance better.

items.titleZh: 肠道微生物群与大脑健康：疾病特异性通路与新兴治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了肠道微生物群通过肠-脑轴影响神经系统疾病（包括ALS）的现有证据。文章指出，不同疾病（如阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、ALS等）存在特异性的肠道微生物特征，但多数机制研究仍基于动物模型，人类数据有限。针对微生物群的干预策略（如益生菌、饮食调整、粪菌移植）在早期研究中显示出潜力，但尚未达到临床应用阶段。
items.insight: 对于ALS研究者，这篇综述提供了肠-脑轴在ALS中作用的全面概览，强调了肠道微生物群作为潜在治疗靶点的可能性，同时指出了当前研究的局限性和未来方向，有助于设计更严谨的临床前和临床研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: 肠道微生物群通过多种机制影响CNS稳态，不同神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）存在疾病特异性的微生物特征，但证据强度不一，干预措施仍处于早期阶段。
aiRead.limitation: 综述依赖现有文献，许多机制证据来自动物模型，人类研究异质性大，且未提供原始数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对ALS的纵向队列研究，以及微生物群干预（如益生菌或粪菌移植）在ALS患者中的随机对照试验结果。

items.abstractZh: 微生物群-肠-脑轴（MGBA）已成为一个动态的双向通讯系统，通过神经、免疫、内分泌和代谢机制连接胃肠道与中枢神经系统（CNS）。越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物群落的改变与多种神经系统疾病相关；然而，这种关联的强度因疾病而异，许多机制性观察仍主要依赖于实验模型而非人类研究。本综述概述了关于肠道微生物群在维持CNS稳态中作用的现有证据，特别强调肠道屏障功能、免疫调节、迷走神经和肠神经系统通讯，以及生物活性微生物代谢产物（包括短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质相关化合物）的产生。临床和实验研究均报告了阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多发性硬化症、自闭症谱系障碍和肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病中的疾病特异性微生物特征。与此同时，针对微生物群的干预措施——包括益生菌、益生元、饮食方法、粪便微生物群移植以及靶向微生物代谢产物的策略——在临床前研究和早期临床研究中取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，研究人群、实验方法和治疗方案中的显著异质性仍限制了这些发现向常规临床实践的转化。总体而言，现有证据支持MGBA作为理解神经系统疾病的有价值框架，同时强调需要严格设计的纵向研究和良好对照的临床试验，以更好地确定其治疗相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的肠-脑轴研究，并明确将ALS列为疾病特异性微生物特征之一，为ALS的微生物靶向治疗提供了转化研究基础。

items.title: The Anterior Belly of the Digastric Muscle as a Novel Target for Needle Electromyography in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Needle electromyography (EMG) in the bulbar region aids in the diagnosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) but remains technically challenging. The genioglossus muscle (GM) is commonly examined; however, pain and poor relaxation may limit its evaluation. The trapezius is an alternative target but is innervated by the spinal accessory nerve. We investigated the utility of the anterior belly of the digastric muscle (ABDM), innervated by the trigeminal nerve, for bulbar EMG evaluation. In this unblinded, prospective observational study, consecutive patients with suspected ALS underwent needle EMG of the ABDM, GM, masseter muscle (MM), and trapezius. Relaxation levels, EMG abnormalities, and pain (100-mm visual analog scale [VAS]) were assessed. Twenty-seven clinically diagnosed ALS patients were analyzed. Relaxation was better in the ABDM than in the GM (p < 0.001) and comparable to that in the MM and trapezius. Fasciculation potentials were detected more often in the ABDM (52%) than in the GM (0%) and MM (22%; p = 0.039) and were comparable to the trapezius (59%). Chronic denervation occurred at similar frequencies across muscles (33%-59%). The combination of abnormal spontaneous activity and chronic denervation was most frequent in the ABDM (37%). Pain was lower with the ABDM (median VAS score of 21) than with the GM (28; p = 0.0052) and MM (32; p < 0.001) and was similar to the trapezius (23). The ABDM may be a practical additional target for bulbar EMG in ALS, with favorable relaxation, lower pain, and potentially improved electrodiagnostic yield.
items.titleZh: 二腹肌前腹作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症针极肌电图检查的新靶点
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了二腹肌前腹（ABDM）作为ALS延髓肌电图检查新靶点的可行性。结果显示，与常规的颏舌肌相比，ABDM在检查时患者放松更好、疼痛更轻，且束颤电位检出率更高（52% vs 0%），与斜方肌相当。研究者认为ABDM可作为延髓EMG的实用补充靶点，可能提高电诊断效率。
items.insight: 延髓起病ALS的诊断常受限于肌电图检查的技术难度和患者耐受性。该研究首次系统评估了二腹肌前腹这一三叉神经支配肌肉作为EMG靶点的价值，其更优的放松度和更低的疼痛可能改善患者配合度，而较高的束颤检出率提示其可能提高延髓区域电诊断的敏感性，为临床实践提供了新的可选方案。

aiRead.studyType: 前瞻性、非盲、观察性临床研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 二腹肌前腹在ALS患者中比颏舌肌具有更好的放松度、更低的疼痛和更高的束颤电位检出率，可作为延髓EMG的实用附加靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（27例），为非盲设计，且未报告与其他延髓肌电图检查方法的诊断准确性比较。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该靶点在更大样本、多中心研究中的验证，以及其与临床预后或疾病进展标志物的关联性分析。

items.abstractZh: 延髓区域的针极肌电图（EMG）有助于肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的诊断，但在技术上仍具挑战性。颏舌肌（GM）是常规检查部位，但疼痛和放松不佳可能限制其评估。斜方肌是替代靶点，但由副神经支配。本研究探讨了由三叉神经支配的二腹肌前腹（ABDM）在延髓EMG评估中的效用。在这项非盲、前瞻性观察性研究中，连续纳入疑似ALS患者，对其ABDM、GM、咬肌（MM）和斜方肌进行针极EMG检查。评估了放松程度、EMG异常和疼痛（100mm视觉模拟量表[VAS]）。共分析了27例临床确诊的ALS患者。ABDM的放松程度优于GM（p < 0.001），与MM和斜方肌相当。ABDM的束颤电位检出率（52%）高于GM（0%）和MM（22%；p = 0.039），与斜方肌（59%）相当。慢性失神经支配在各肌肉中的发生率相似（33%-59%）。异常自发电活动与慢性失神经支配的组合在ABDM中最常见（37%）。ABDM的疼痛评分（VAS中位数21）低于GM（28；p = 0.0052）和MM（32；p < 0.001），与斜方肌（23）相似。ABDM可能作为ALS延髓EMG检查的一个实用附加靶点，具有放松良好、疼痛较轻以及可能提高电诊断检出率的优势。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，直接针对ALS延髓诊断的临床痛点，提出并验证了一个新的肌电图检查靶点，具有直接的临床转化价值。

items.title: Macrophage responses to and elevated antibody levels against Chlorovirus ATCV-1 in ALS patients.
items.summary: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) is a giant virus that is part of the human oral microvirome. Previously we showed that ATCV-1 infects mouse macrophages, stimulates production of inflammatory cytokines, and accelerates motor neuron disease in the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) model SOD1-G93A transgenic mice. This, coupled with significantly elevated levels of serum IgG1 antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls, suggests involvement of ATCV-1 in ALS. Herein, using serum and CSF from a different ALS cohort we again show elevated antibodies to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls. To assess ATCV-1 in human macrophages, we challenged immature (IMM), M0, M1, and M2 human THP-1 macrophage cells containing an Interferon Stimulated Response Element (ISRE) promoter-reporter with ATCV-1 or its Major Capsid protein (MCP) glycans. ATCV-1 infected M1 THP-1 to a greater degree than IMM, M0, or M2 THP-1. The initial high ISRE-promoter activity of M1 THP-1 was suppressed by the MCP-Glycans of ATCV-1. M0, but not IMM or M2 THP-1 produced IL-6 in response to ATCV-1 or its MCP-glycan, while high levels of IL-6 from unchallenged M1 THP-1 increased further by ATCV-1 or its MCP glycan. In contrast, ATCV-1 or its MCP-Glycan significantly reduced the high levels of IL-10 produced by M2 THP-1. Thus, antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients and the susceptibility of human M1 macrophages to ATCV-1 infection with boosted inflammatory cytokine and diminished anti-inflammatory cytokine production suggest that ATCV-1 may contribute to ALS motor neuron disease.
items.titleZh: ALS患者巨噬细胞对Chlorovirus ATCV-1的反应及抗体水平升高
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，ALS患者体内针对ATCV-1病毒的抗体水平高于健康人，且该病毒能优先感染促炎型M1巨噬细胞，增强炎症反应并抑制抗炎反应，提示病毒感染可能通过免疫调节参与ALS的病理过程。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS的病毒感染假说提供了新证据，特别是ATCV-1可能通过影响巨噬细胞极化状态（促进M1、抑制M2）来加剧神经炎症，为ALS的免疫调节治疗和生物标志物开发提供了新方向。

items.abstractZh: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1)是一种巨型病毒，属于人类口腔微生物组的一部分。此前研究表明，ATCV-1可感染小鼠巨噬细胞，刺激炎症细胞因子产生，并加速肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）模型SOD1-G93A转基因小鼠的运动神经元疾病进展。此外，与健康对照相比，ALS患者血清中针对ATCV-1的IgG1抗体水平显著升高，提示ATCV-1可能参与ALS发病。本研究使用来自不同ALS队列的血清和脑脊液，再次证实ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体水平高于健康对照。为评估ATCV-1对人巨噬细胞的作用，研究人员使用含有干扰素刺激反应元件（ISRE）启动子报告基因的未成熟（IMM）、M0、M1和M2人THP-1巨噬细胞，分别用ATCV-1或其主要衣壳蛋白（MCP）聚糖进行刺激。结果显示，ATCV-1对M1 THP-1细胞的感染程度高于IMM、M0或M2 THP-1细胞。ATCV-1的MCP聚糖抑制了M1 THP-1细胞初始高水平的ISRE启动子活性。M0（而非IMM或M2）THP-1细胞在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖刺激下产生IL-6，而未受刺激的M1 THP-1细胞本身高水平的IL-6在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖作用下进一步升高。相反，ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖显著降低了M2 THP-1细胞产生的高水平IL-10。因此，ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体以及人M1巨噬细胞对ATCV-1感染的易感性（伴随炎症细胞因子增强和抗炎细胞因子减少）提示ATCV-1可能促进ALS运动神经元疾病的发展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合了临床样本（ALS患者抗体水平）和体外细胞实验，揭示了特定病毒（ATCV-1）对巨噬细胞亚型的选择性作用，为ALS的病毒-免疫交互机制提供了新近的转化证据。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项针对美国退伍军人的大规模纵向研究发现，ALS发病率与军种和军衔显著相关。空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者风险高于陆军，海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险高于士兵；服役年限越长风险反而越低。这些差异在年轻退伍军人中尤为明显。研究提示特定军事环境暴露可能增加ALS风险。
items.insight: 这项研究是迄今规模最大的关于军事服役细节与ALS风险关联的分析之一，首次系统揭示了军种和军衔对ALS发病率的影响，为识别具体致病暴露因素提供了关键线索，对理解ALS环境风险因素具有重要价值。

items.abstractZh: 军事服役是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服役的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军事人员中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国（US）军种和军衔与偶发性ALS的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，纳入2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。偶发性ALS通过医疗记录识别。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。风险使用Cox比例风险模型估计，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例偶发性ALS病例，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例病例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与更高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低的发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在按年龄分层的模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51）中最大，在年长男性（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）中最小。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而有显著差异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境中。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于近千万退伍军人的最新纵向数据（2000-2024年），首次系统量化了军种和军衔对ALS风险的影响，具有直接的ALS病因学转化价值。

items.title: Label-free proteomic profiling identifies ECM-related alterations across regeneration states in human peripheral axonal neuropathies.
items.summary: Understanding the multiple mechanisms underlying peripheral nerve regeneration in humans is crucial for developing effective therapies for peripheral axonal neuropathies. Although in vitro and in vivo studies have provided significant insights, human studies exploring the composition of proteome remain limited. The ECM plays a crucial role in nerve regeneration, influencing cell adhesion, proliferation, migration, and finally differentiation. In this study, we used a high-sensitivity, label-free liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) method to investigate the global proteomic profile of human sural nerves aiming to identify molecular dynamics that promote or hinder nerve regeneration in well-characterized cohorts of patients with acute axonal injury, regenerating axonal neuropathy, and non-regenerating axonal neuropathy. Overall, 149 proteins were identified, of which 68 showed significant modulation across the groups. Proteins over-represented in regenerating nerves highlighted the multifactorial nature of regeneration, including immune modulation, debris clearance, cytoskeletal reorganization, axonal extension, and lipid transport. Conversely, structural myelin and neuronal proteins were significantly downregulated in non-regenerating nerves. Among the differentially expressed proteins, functional enrichment analysis revealed a significant overrepresentation of ECM-related components, providing compelling evidence that the ECM is not merely a passive scaffold, but an active driver of peripheral nerve regeneration.
items.titleZh: 无标记蛋白质组学分析揭示人类周围神经轴突病变不同再生状态下的细胞外基质相关改变
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用高灵敏度无标记质谱技术，分析了人类腓肠神经在急性损伤、再生性和非再生性轴突神经病变三种状态下的蛋白质组。研究发现68种蛋白在组间显著变化，再生神经中富集免疫调节、碎片清除、细胞骨架重组等蛋白，而非再生神经中髓鞘和神经元蛋白显著下调。特别值得注意的是，细胞外基质（ECM）相关蛋白显著富集，提示ECM是神经再生的主动驱动因素而非被动支架。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS研究者提供了重要参考：ALS本质上也涉及轴突变性和再生失败，本研究揭示的ECM主动调控神经再生的机制，可能为理解ALS中运动神经元轴突再生障碍提供新的分子靶点，尤其是ECM相关蛋白作为潜在治疗干预方向值得关注。

aiRead.limitation: 样本量可能有限，且仅分析了腓肠神经这一特定周围神经，结果是否适用于中枢神经系统或ALS运动神经元尚需验证。

items.abstractZh: 理解人类周围神经再生背后的多种机制，对于开发治疗周围神经轴突病变的有效疗法至关重要。尽管体外和体内研究提供了重要见解，但探索蛋白质组组成的人类研究仍然有限。细胞外基质（ECM）在神经再生中起着关键作用，影响细胞粘附、增殖、迁移以及最终的分化。本研究采用高灵敏度、无标记的液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）方法，调查人类腓肠神经的整体蛋白质组谱，旨在识别在特征明确的急性轴突损伤、再生性轴突神经病变和非再生性轴突神经病变患者队列中，促进或阻碍神经再生的分子动态变化。共鉴定出149种蛋白质，其中68种在各组间表现出显著调节。在再生神经中过度表达的蛋白质突显了再生的多因素性质，包括免疫调节、碎片清除、细胞骨架重组、轴突延伸和脂质转运。相反，结构性的髓鞘和神经元蛋白在非再生神经中显著下调。在差异表达蛋白中，功能富集分析揭示了ECM相关成分的显著过度表达，提供了有力证据表明ECM不仅仅是被动支架，而是周围神经再生的主动驱动因素。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用最新高灵敏度无标记蛋白质组学技术，直接分析人类周围神经组织，揭示了ECM在神经再生中的主动驱动作用，为ALS等神经退行性疾病的再生治疗提供了新的转化研究视角。

items.title: Factors associated with requests for Medical Assistance in Dying (MAiD) referral among patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis receiving specialist palliative care.
items.summary: Patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) have among the highest rates of medical assistance in dying (MAiD), yet factors associated with requesting MAiD remain poorly understood. We examined sociodemographic and clinical characteristics associated with MAiD referral and receipt among patients with ALS receiving specialist palliative care. We conducted a retrospective sequentially matched cohort study of patients attending a multidisciplinary ALS clinic at a Canadian tertiary care center. Patients who requested a MAiD referral were matched with the next consecutive patient without a MAiD request. Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with MAiD referral and, among referred patients, receipt of MAiD. The cohort included 272 patients (130 MAiD referrals; 142 no referral). Rural residence was independently associated with higher odds of requesting a MAiD referral (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 2.38, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.02-5.58), whereas non-invasive ventilation (NIV) was associated with lower odds (aOR 0.56, 95% CI 0.32-0.90). Gastrostomy tube use demonstrated a non-significant trend toward lower odds of MAiD referral (aOR 0.59, 95%CI 0.33-1.07). Age, sex, and limb and bulbar symptom severity were not associated with MAiD referral. Among patients referred for MAiD, no factors were independently associated with receipt of MAiD. In patients with ALS receiving specialist palliative care, use of NIV was associated with a lower likelihood of requesting a MAiD referral, while rural residence was associated with higher odds of referral. These findings suggest that decisions regarding MAiD may be influenced less by disease severity than by preferences regarding life-prolonging interventions and warrant further investigation.

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者中医疗协助死亡（MAiD）的使用率最高，但与申请MAiD相关的因素仍知之甚少。我们研究了接受专科姑息治疗的ALS患者中与MAiD转诊和接受相关的社会人口学和临床特征。我们在加拿大三级医疗中心的多学科ALS门诊进行了一项回顾性序贯匹配队列研究。申请MAiD转诊的患者与下一个未申请MAiD的连续患者进行匹配。多变量逻辑回归分析确定了与MAiD转诊相关的因素，以及在转诊患者中与接受MAiD相关的因素。队列包括272名患者（130例MAiD转诊；142例无转诊）。农村居住地与申请MAiD转诊的较高几率独立相关（调整后比值比[aOR] 2.38，95%置信区间[CI] 1.02-5.58），而无创通气（NIV）与较低几率相关（aOR 0.56，95%CI 0.32-0.90）。胃造口管使用显示MAiD转诊几率降低的非显著趋势（aOR 0.59，95%CI 0.33-1.07）。年龄、性别、肢体和延髓症状严重程度与MAiD转诊无关。在转诊MAiD的患者中，没有因素与接受MAiD独立相关。在接受专科姑息治疗的ALS患者中，使用NIV与申请MAiD转诊的可能性较低相关，而农村居住地与转诊几率较高相关。这些发现表明，MAiD的决定可能受疾病严重程度的影响较小，而更多受关于延长生命干预措施偏好的影响，值得进一步研究。

items.title: Multidisciplinary clinic attendance and patterns of care in the U.S. National ALS Registry, 2013-2023.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) multidisciplinary clinics (MDCs) are the standard model of care, but national-level data on utilization and outcomes in the United States are lacking. To compare baseline characteristics and symptoms, clinical interventions and specialized care processes, and healthcare utilization among U.S. National ALS Registry (Registry) participants by MDC attendance. Registry data from 2013 to 2023 were analyzed for participants completing demographic and clinical surveys, stratified by MDC attendance (attendance vs. no attendance by survey completion). Among 4764 participants, 77.0% reported attending an MDC. Baseline characteristics were similar between groups, including sex, age at diagnosis, and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Functional Rating Scale-Revised (ALSFRS-R) scores. MDC attendees reported lower prevalence of dysphagia (23.6% vs. 27.5%, p = 0.007) and bowel/bladder issues (10.7% vs. 14.3%, p = 0.001). Attendees were more likely to use evidence-based interventions, including wheelchairs/scooters, noninvasive ventilation, percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG), communication devices, and ALS disease-modifying therapies, specifically riluzole (72.7% vs. 48.1%) and edaravone (10.5% vs. 2.6%) (all p < 0.001). MDC attendees also demonstrated higher rates of specialized care processes, including advance directive completion, genetic testing, and prior research participation (all p < 0.001). For healthcare utilization, MDC attendance was associated with fewer emergency department visits among those with any use (RR 0.90, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.82-0.99) and shorter hospital stays ( β = -2.67 days, 95% CI -4.56 to -0.78). MDC attendance was associated with greater uptake of evidence-based interventions, higher rates of specialized care processes, and reduced healthcare utilization intensity, consistent with previously reported multidisciplinary ALS care outcomes.

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）多学科门诊（MDC）是标准护理模式，但美国缺乏关于其使用情况和结局的国家级数据。本研究旨在比较美国国家ALS登记处（Registry）参与者中，按MDC就诊情况（在完成调查时是否就诊）分层的基线特征、症状、临床干预、专科护理流程及医疗资源使用情况。研究分析了2013年至2023年期间完成人口学和临床调查的登记处参与者数据。在4764名参与者中，77.0%报告曾在MDC就诊。两组基线特征相似，包括性别、诊断年龄和ALS功能评定量表修订版（ALSFRS-R）评分。MDC就诊者吞咽困难（23.6% vs. 27.5%，p = 0.007）和肠道/膀胱问题（10.7% vs. 14.3%，p = 0.001）的报告率较低。就诊者更可能使用循证干预措施，包括轮椅/代步车、无创通气、经皮内镜下胃造瘘术（PEG）、沟通辅助设备以及ALS疾病修饰治疗，特别是利鲁唑（72.7% vs. 48.1%）和依达拉奉（10.5% vs. 2.6%）（均p < 0.001）。MDC就诊者还表现出更高的专科护理流程使用率，包括预先指示完成、基因检测和既往研究参与（均p < 0.001）。在医疗资源使用方面，MDC就诊与急诊就诊次数减少（有就诊者中RR 0.90，95%置信区间0.82-0.99）和住院时间缩短（β = -2.67天，95% CI -4.56至-0.78）相关。MDC就诊与循证干预措施使用增加、专科护理流程率提高以及医疗资源使用强度降低相关，这与先前报道的多学科ALS护理结局一致。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2013-2023年美国国家ALS登记处的最新数据，直接评估了多学科门诊这一ALS标准护理模式在真实世界中的利用率和结局，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。
